page.overview:
What is Mount Lanakila?

Mount Lanakila is the highest peak in the Alola region. It is located on Ula'ula Island and is north of the Tapu Village. It is the only place that experiences snowfall in Alola.

It is the place where Crabrawler can evolve into Crabominable.
